title: Read Hangul
text: Use the Hangul lessons in this app first. Keep Duolingo as a light daily extra. If a letter or rule is still unclear, read How to Study Korean Unit 0.

title: One course for grammar
text: Pick one structured course and make it your active course: First Step Korean, or GO! Billy’s numbered beginner course if you want it free. Look words up in the NIKL learners’ dictionary or Naver.

title: Listen and speak
text: Move on to Learn to Speak Korean 1. Add the beginner conversation podcast for listening, and start one language exchange app for a few messages a week.

title: Get ready to land
text: Download Papago’s offline Korean pack. Read UNIST’s inbound pages and the Ulsan city site. Consider two or three italki lessons to practise speaking with a real person.

title: Keep going in Korea
text: Keep your daily reviews. Use Visit Korea for weekend trips. If you want a goal for the semester, try a TOPIK I mock test.
